summary: An unexpected alternative can show you that the rule you were rebelling against was never the only way to do this.
body: An unexpected alternative can show you that the rule you were rebelling against was never the only way to do this. When Uranus sextiles Lilith, a new tool, different schedule, unconventional collaborator, alternate route, or last-minute opening can make a private refusal practical instead of merely defiant. You may not have to fight the old arrangement head-on if another option lets you stop depending on it. Try the workaround before you turn the conflict into a referendum on your freedom. The useful change is the one that gives you a workable choice you did not have before, not simply a louder way to reject the old one.
